instruction: Use the already opened Bonsai/Blender IFC authoring environment and its CLI/API tools to update /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc and save the finished model as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. Do not create, rewrite, copy, patch, or post-process the IFC outside that software environment. The model is a one-storey duplex with two small dwelling units sharing a party wall. The owner wants the handover model to clearly separate Unit A and Unit B while preserving the current doors, windows, room layout, and exterior shell. Treat the living and bedroom spaces on each side as their own unit package, add practical residential room references, and keep the party wall identifiable as the acoustic separation between the units. Use the same masonry-and-gypsum wall language across the duplex and mark the coordinated unit data with revision code BONSAI-CLI-05.
